needs_result.entry: Image Classification — CNN and Transfer Learning
needs_result.text: Trained a PyTorch CNN on CIFAR-10 and compared it with ImageNet pretrained ResNet50 transfer learning (frozen backbone, new 10 class head), judged by confusion matrices and validation loss rather than accuracy alone.

bullets.text: Built scikit-learn pipelines and LSTM/BiRNN/CNN models in TensorFlow/Keras, deployed as FastAPI services in Docker.

Built the Python data pipeline: reconciled 14 heterogeneous source datasets through identifier crosswalks so the agent used trusted data, then deployed it as a Docker image on AWS Lambda (ECR, least-privilege IAM) and documented the architecture and evaluation.

Working independently for India-based startups and individual clients, built agentic RAG workflows (LangChain, LangGraph, ChromaDB) on GCP Cloud Run, NLP pipelines (Hugging Face Transformers, Ollama) and scikit-learn pipelines, served ML models as REST APIs (FastAPI, Docker), and contributed to a team LoRA fine-tune of a Llama model.
Text-to-speech on CUDA in float16 with start-up warm-up, packaged in an nvidia/cuda Docker image.

bullets.entry: Image Classification — CNN and Transfer Learning
bullets.text: Trained a PyTorch CNN on CIFAR-10 and compared it with ImageNet pretrained ResNet50 transfer learning (frozen backbone, new 10 class head), judged by confusion matrices and validation loss rather than accuracy alone.

bullets.entry: GTAI Cell Line Finder — multi-omics graph for cancer cell-line selection (PoC)
bullets.text: Trained per-gene regression models for 11,459 genes (OLS and GPU random forest) with resumable chunked training, cutting RAM from 8.2 to 5.5 GB, and validated them on held-out data, surfacing overfitting (train Pearson 0.807 vs test 0.545).

bullets.entry: CoverFit — insurance benchmarking API (Bristol × UWE AI Hackathon)
bullets.text: An insurance sponsor needed a fast, low-cost, explainable benchmark (hackathon brief): paired a deterministic matching engine (FastAPI, pandas, Pydantic) with a single LLM call (Gemini via LiteLLM) for the rationale, covered by pytest tests; responses arrive in under 3 seconds at ~£0.003 per query.

Built a tool-calling LLM agent (LangChain, AWS Bedrock, Claude Haiku 4.5) for a multi-omics cancer research platform, with three tools for gene alias resolution, scoring-methodology explanation and dataset provenance.
Deployed the agent as a Docker container on AWS Lambda (Lambda Web Adapter) with ECR image pipelines, IAM execution roles and least-privilege policies.
Proposed and prototyped an MCP-based agentic tool in Python (FastMCP, Ollama gpt-oss:20b, PostgreSQL, GitHub Actions CI), presented in a live stakeholder demo.

skills.Machine Learning, Deep Learning & Statis: Predictive modelling (gradient boosting with XGBoost, random forest, scikit-learn), clustering (K-Means, HAC, DBSCAN, Leiden), deep learning (PyTorch, TensorFlow/Keras, LSTM, GRU, BiRNN, CNN), time-series forecasting (cyclic time encoding, TimeSeriesSplit), anomaly detection (Isolation Forest), class-imbalance handling (SMOTE), hyper-parameter tuning (grid search, two-stage Bayesian), model evaluation (held-out, cross-validation, Pearson, MCC), statistical inference and experimental design (confidence intervals, bootstrap, hypothesis testing; MSc coursework), MLflow experiment tracking
skills.Python, Data Quality & Cloud: Python, pandas, NumPy, SciPy, Matplotlib, Seaborn, Plotly, SQL, PostgreSQL, R (tidymodels), identifier crosswalks, parquet, reproducible pipelines, AWS (Lambda, ECR, IAM, S3, Bedrock), GCP (Cloud Run), Docker, Kubernetes (AWS EKS), serverless deployment (Lambda, Cloud Run), containerisation, GitHub Actions CI/CD, FastAPI, TensorFlow Serving, pytest, Git
skills.NLP, LLMs, Embeddings & Evaluation: NLP (text preprocessing, TF-IDF, SBERT embeddings, text clustering), Hugging Face Transformers, large language models (Claude, OpenAI, open-weight via Ollama), prompt engineering, RAG with embeddings (ChromaDB), agents (LangChain, LangGraph), team LoRA fine-tune of Llama, LLM evaluation (hallucination-rate analysis, deterministic guardrails)
skills.Client Delivery & Communication: Scoping ambiguous problems with clients, stakeholder demos, working with client engineering teams, code review, transparent reporting of model limitations, root-cause analysis, technical documentation

experience.title: Data Scientist
experience.situation: Needed an LLM a research team could trust before it shipped
bullets: Diagnosed where it struggled with a three-tier, ~65-test evaluation harness (tool-level → API → live) and hallucination-rate analysis, debugging failures layer by layer, and used the same harness to validate the Groq to Bedrock migration after a rate-limit evaluation.

Built the Python data pipeline: reconciled 14 heterogeneous source datasets through identifier crosswalks so the agent used trusted data, then deployed it as a Docker image on AWS Lambda (ECR, least-privilege IAM) and documented the architecture and evaluation.

experience.title: Data Consultant (AI Engineering & AI System)
experience.situation: Faced a loosely defined problem from a Madrid based startup client
bullets: A product-startup client needed an agentic AI prototype turned into software their team could use: led the architecture for a five-person cross-functional team, designed hierarchical agent workflows (MCP, Exograph GraphQL, PostgreSQL for persistent storage and retrieval across agent sessions) and built the Python prototype (FastMCP, Ollama, GitHub Actions CI), then ran a live demo with client stakeholders (5-star rating from senior leadership) within the three-month engagement.

Carried it into production with the client's engineering team: contributed to their production TypeScript/Node.js MCP server (OpenAI-based query generation, Convex), now in live use, and reviewed pull requests in the client's production repository alongside their CTO.
